blob-opera.title: Blob Opera - Free Online Music Game
blob-opera.description: Blob Opera is a unique music game that lets you compose opera with blobs. Drag and adjust the blobs to create harmonious melodies. Perfect for all skill levels, Blob Opera offers a fun and creative way to explore music. Start playing Blob Opera today and unleash your inner composer!

HomeFeatures.gameTitle: Blob Opera - Free Online Music Game
HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Blob Opera is a music game created by David Li in collaboration with Google Arts & Culture. It uses a machine learning model trained on the voices of four opera singers to produce a practical and entertaining music game that anybody can enjoy.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Drag the mouse to help the blobs reach specific pitches.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Adjust the blobs to create harmonious melodies.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Explore different musical styles and create your own opera.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Blob Opera allows you to create music interactively by adjusting the blobs.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: The game uses a machine learning model trained on opera singers' voices.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Blob Opera is simple to understand and play, perfect for all skill levels.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Explore different musical styles and create your own unique opera.
